note: The city 2011 general election summary shows a mayoral race with Adame 9,442 of 13,136 votes (71.88 percent), so no mayoral runoff was needed. The city PDF prints no election date. The Texas Secretary of State Election Advisory No. 2011-03 (Wayback copy) names May 14, 2011 as the uniform election date for the spring 2011 general election. The city report print stamp is May 16, 2011, which fits that date. The June 18, 2011 city runoff PDF lists only a District 3 table and no mayoral result.
